title: Signed finite Tate powers have coherent ordinary pullback and multiplication
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and m>0 with mA=0. For the signed finite Tate sheaves A_T(a) on schemes T with m invertible [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf], there exist isomorphisms c_v,a:v^{-1}A_T(a) -> A_Tprime(a) for every morphism v:Tprime -> T, and p_T,a,b:A_T(a) tensor A_T(b) -> A_T(a+b). The degree-one adjunct of c sends a tensor z to a tensor the canonical pulled-back root, using the canonical kernel map of lem-asd-source-roots-pullback-invertible-exponent. Degree zero is the canonical constant-sheaf comparison and positive powers follow the displayed strong-monoidal recursion. Negative powers preserve evaluation. The c satisfy canonical identity and composition laws. The p satisfy left and right unit laws, positive-successor identity, associativity with degree transport, symmetry, and positive-negative evaluation. The c preserve p through the strong monoidal comparison. These thirteen formulas are exactly the Lean signature; the statement makes no assertion about derived tensor or exponent change.

proof.text: Use the common cover of lem-asd-finite-twist-common-local-bases and the normalized source roots comparison lem-asd-source-roots-pullback-invertible-exponent. Extend scalars and sheafify the additive roots adjunct. It is ZMod m-linear because pullback preserves powers, and on generators gives the specified pure-tensor formula. Strong monoidality gives positive recursion and the canonical constant comparison gives degree zero.

proof.text: Pull back the evaluation of a locally free line and use the inverse positive comparison in its first variable to define the negative comparison. On the pulled-back common cover it identifies the dual basis, so is invertible and satisfies the evaluation equation.

source.place: Tag 03PK, section-kummer; finite scalar extension and signed powers

proof.text: Define p on basis tensors by basis[a] tensor basis[b] |-> basis[a+b], with mixed signs contracted by evaluation. If the line basis changes by the unit u, basis[a] changes by u^a for every integer a, so these maps descend independently of the basis. The zero and positive-successor maps are the stated unitors and identity. Both paths in associativity, symmetry, and evaluation send every basis tensor to the same basis tensor with the same coefficient; therefore these identities hold.

proof.text: The identity, composition, and tensor diagrams for c agree on local basis tensors because the roots adjunct preserves their coefficient and ring pullback composes. In the negative degrees the evaluation identity uniquely determines the dual comparison. Thus all thirteen stated identities descend as equalities of sheaf morphisms.

theorem finiteEtaleTwistSignedCoherence (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hA : (m : A) = 0) :
    ∃ (c : ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T),
        IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)) → IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤)) → ∀ a : ℤ,
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).obj (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) ≅
          finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T' hA a)
      (p : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}), IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)) → ∀ a b : ℤ,
        finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a ⊗ finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA b ≅
          finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (a + b)),
(∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)))
        (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤))) (W : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : A)
        (z : (T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m).obj.obj W),
      ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).homEquiv _ _
        (c v hT hT' 1).hom).hom.app W (finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m T hA W a z) =
      finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m T' hA
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).op.obj W) a
        (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v).homEquiv _ _
          (upperStarRootsOfUnitySheafToRootsOfUnitySheaf m v)).hom.app W z)) ∧
    (∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)))
        (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤))),
      c v hT hT' 0 = (upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).app
        (ModuleCat.of A A)) ∧
    (∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)))
        (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤))) (n : ℕ),
      c v hT hT' (.ofNat (n + 2)) =
        asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v)
          (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (.ofNat (n + 1))) (finiteEtaleTateLine T m A hA)) ≪≫
          tensorIso (c v hT hT' (.ofNat (n + 1))) (c v hT hT' 1)) ∧
    (∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)))
        (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤))) (n : ℕ),
      (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).map
          ((ihom.ev (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (.ofNat (n + 1)))).app
            (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA 0)) ≫ (c v hT hT' 0).hom =
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v)
          (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (.ofNat (n + 1)))
          (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (.negSucc n)) ≫
          tensorHom (c v hT hT' (.ofNat (n + 1))).hom (c v hT hT' (.negSucc n)).hom ≫
          (ihom.ev (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T' hA (.ofNat (n + 1)))).app
            (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T' hA 0)) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (a : ℤ),
      c (𝟙 T) hT hT a = (Etale.upperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).app
        (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a)) ∧
    (∀ {T T' T'' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (w : T'' ⟶ T')
        (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤)))
        (hT'' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T'', ⊤))) (a : ℤ),
      c (w ≫ v) hT hT'' a =
        (Etale.upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w v).app
          (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) ≪≫
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w).mapIso (c v hT hT' a) ≪≫
          c w hT' hT'' a) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (a : ℤ),
      p T hT 0 a = λ_ (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA) (zero_add a).symm)) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (a : ℤ),
      p T hT a 0 = ρ_ (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA) (add_zero a).symm)) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (n : ℕ),
      p T hT (.ofNat (n + 1)) 1 = Iso.refl _) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (a b d : ℤ),
      (p T hT a b).hom ▷ finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA d ≫ (p T hT (a + b) d).hom =
        (α_ (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA b)
          (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA d)).hom ≫
        finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a ◁ (p T hT b d).hom ≫
          (p T hT a (b + d)).hom ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA) (add_assoc a b d).symm)) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (a b : ℤ),
      (β_ (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA b)).hom ≫
          (p T hT b a).hom ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA) (add_comm b a)) =
        (p T hT a b).hom) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (n : ℕ),
      (p T hT (.ofNat (n + 1)) (.negSucc n)).hom ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA)
            (add_neg_cancel (Int.ofNat (n + 1)))) =
        (ihom.ev (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (.ofNat (n + 1)))).app
          (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA 0)) ∧
    (∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)))
        (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤))) (a b : ℤ),
      (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).map (p T hT a b).hom ≫
          (c v hT hT' (a + b)).hom =
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v)
          (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA b) ≫
        tensorHom (c v hT hT' a).hom (c v hT hT' b).hom ≫ (p T' hT' a b).hom)
